This project investigates chloroplast genome variation and phylogenetic
relationships within the genus *Taraxacum*.

publication-ready scientific manuscript based on chloroplast genome assemblies,
metadata, sequence variation, plastome structure, PCA, and phylogenetic inference.

"""Локальная проверка типов и domain/range рёбер заметок ontology.yaml."""

import json
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

try:
    import yaml
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    bundled_python = ROOT.parent / "AI4Science/.venv/bin/python3"
    if bundled_python.exists() and Path(sys.executable).resolve() != bundled_python.resolve():
        os.execv(str(bundled_python), [str(bundled_python), str(Path(__file__).resolve()), *sys.argv[1:]])
    raise


def values(value):
    return set(value if isinstance(value, list) else [value])


def main():
    schema = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / "ontology.yaml").read_text())
    errors, nodes, edges = [], {}, []
    for path in [*(ROOT / "notes").glob("*.md"), *(ROOT / "tasks").glob("*.md")]:
        text = path.read_text()
        title = next((line[2:] for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("# ")), path.stem)
        m = re.search(r"(?m)^type:\s*(\S+)", text)
        if m:
            nodes[title] = (m.group(1), text, path)

    def is_a(actual, expected):
        parent = actual
        while parent:
            if parent == expected:
                return True
            parent = schema["classes"].get(parent, {}).get("parent")
        return False

    for title, (source_type, text, path) in nodes.items():
        if source_type not in schema["classes"]:
            errors.append(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)}: неизвестный класс {source_type}")
            continue
        for relation, target in re.findall(r"(?m)^- ([^:\n]+): \[\[([^\]\n]+)\]\]", text):
            if relation == "тип":
                if target not in schema["classes"]:
                    errors.append(f"{path.name}: неизвестный класс типа {target}")
                continue
            spec = schema["properties"].get(relation)
            if not spec:
                errors.append(f"{path.name}: отношение {relation} отсутствует в ontology.yaml")
                continue
            if not any(is_a(source_type, c) for c in values(spec["domain"])):
                errors.append(f"{path.name}: domain {source_type} не допускает {relation}")
                continue
            if values(spec["range"]) == {"Файл"}:
                target_path = (ROOT / target).resolve()
                if not target_path.exists():
                    errors.append(f"{path.name}: файл-связь не существует: {target}")
                else:
                    edges.append((title, source_type, relation, "Файл", target))
            else:
                if target not in nodes:
                    errors.append(f"{path.name}: объект-связь не найден: {target}")
                    continue
                target_type = nodes[target][0]
                if not any(is_a(target_type, c) for c in values(spec["range"])):
                    errors.append(f"{path.name}: range {target_type} не допускается для {relation} → {target}")
                else:
                    edges.append((title, source_type, relation, target_type, target))

    # Enforce the declared closed-world rules that have a local checker form.
    for rule in schema.get("rules", []):
        check = rule.get("check", {})
        kind, cls = check.get("kind"), check.get("class")
        instances = [(title, item) for title, item in nodes.items() if is_a(item[0], cls)]
        if kind == "some":
            prop, target_cls = check["property"], check["target"]
            for title, _ in instances:
                if not any(e[0] == title and e[2] == prop and is_a(e[3], target_cls) for e in edges):
                    errors.append(f"{rule['id']}: {title} не связан отношением {prop} с {target_cls}")
        elif kind == "section":
            section = check["section"]
            for title, item in instances:
                if f"## {section}" not in item[1]:
                    errors.append(f"{rule['id']}: {title} без раздела {section}")
        elif kind == "completed_section":
            section = check["section"]
            for title, item in instances:
                status = re.search(r"(?m)^status:\s*(\S+)", item[1])
                if status and status.group(1) in {"выполнена", "принята"} and f"## {section}" not in item[1]:
                    errors.append(f"{rule['id']}: закрытая задача {title} без раздела {section}")
        elif kind == "completed_children":
            relation = check["property"]
            for title, item in instances:
                status = re.search(r"(?m)^status:\s*(\S+)", item[1])
                if not status or status.group(1) not in {"выполнена", "принята"}:
                    continue
                for edge in edges:
                    if edge[2] == relation and edge[4] == title:
                        child = nodes.get(edge[0])
                        child_status = re.search(r"(?m)^status:\s*(\S+)", child[1]) if child else None
                        if not child_status or child_status.group(1) not in {"выполнена", "принята"}:
                            errors.append(f"{rule['id']}: дочерняя задача {edge[0]} не закрыта")

    report = {"checker": "homework/check_graph.py", "status": "passed" if not errors else "failed",
              "object_nodes": len(nodes), "checked_rules": len(schema.get("rules", [])), "errors": errors}
    (ROOT / "reports/homework_graph.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("\n".join(errors) if errors else f"OK: {len(nodes)} объектов, типы и направления связей согласованы")
    return 1 if errors else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
